name: The 2020 pandemic
what: COVID-19 was linked to 14.9 million excess deaths in 2020 and 2021 (range 13.3 to 16.6 million).

name: The rise in war deaths
what: Deaths in fighting involving a state rose from 52,676 in 2019 to 284,981 in 2022, more than five times as many.
source: Uppsala Conflict Data Program and PRIO via Our World in Data
